messages:
maria_cs: Hey @customer_acme — quick check: are you still good to join the QWIK starter-kit walkthrough next Tue? We want to sync on integration and activation milestones.

customer_acme: Yep Tue 10am PT works for us. We still have that SSO hiccup though, Devon said they'd look into it.

devon_csm: I can join Tue. Quick flag: I noticed a renewal-risk tag on this account in the health dashboard — very low usage first week. Recommend we prioritize a short enablement to get them to first-success ASAP.

aj_engineer: FYI the SSO bug is tracked here: https://redwood.ai/bugs/RED-2736 — root cause is missing ACS URL mapping in their IdP. Patch ready, but we need the IdP metadata from ACME to validate.

customer_acme: I can paste metadata today. Also want to capture feedback on prompt templates — we're seeing some hallucination when generating invoice summaries.

maria_cs: Thanks. We'll collect prompt examples with a tiny prework survey before the session. @aj_engineer can you bring 2–3 prompt fix patterns and a quick eval so we can show impact? Also planning a 5-min micro NPS at the end.

aj_engineer: Sure — I'll prepare 3 prompt iterations and a small eval harness. Running locally looks like: 

```bash
python eval_prompt_set.py --model redwood-compact-v1 --prompts prompts.csv
```

I'll bring the results and a suggested changelog.

devon_csm: I'll send the calendar invite. Ownership: Maria = onboarding & logistics, Aj = integration & labs, Devon = renewal follow-up. Meeting plan: walkthrough (30m), hands-on lab (20m), feedback + next steps (10m).

onboard-bot: Reminder created — meeting ID x1234, link https://meet.redwood.com/x1234. Automated prework: 'connect dataset' checklist sent to attendees.

customer_acme: One more ask — can we enable token-level cost dashboard for our finance and infra teams during the trial? Need to show cost per feature before renewal.

maria_cs: Yes — we can grant a 30-day view. Maria to assign temporary viewer permission. Please confirm which emails.

customer_acme: team@acme.co and ops@acme.co.

devon_csm: Action items and owners:
- @aj_engineer: prepare SSO patch instructions + prompt fixes (due: EOD Mon)
- @maria_cs: grant dashboard access + send micro-survey link (due: Mon)
- @customer_acme: share IdP metadata and confirm attendee list (due: Mon)
- @devon_csm: follow-up on renewal playbook & usage ramp (check-in in 2 weeks)

I'll mark renewal risk as 'monitoring' and update the CS playbook with the plan.

maria_cs: :thumbsup:

aj_engineer: Quick question — does ACME expect long-context flows? If so we need a different batching & KV cache config.

customer_acme: Yes, long-context for invoices (8k).

aj_engineer: Got it. I'll bring recommendations for quantization vs latency trade-offs and a config snippet to test in Dedicated.

maria_cs: Also please fill the short pre-session form so we can prioritize examples: https://forms.redwood.com/prework/acme-quickstart

customer_acme: Done — metadata shared via DM. Looking forward to the session.

devon_csm: Great. I'll post a short recap after the meeting with assigned owners, dates, and any follow-ups. See you Tue.
